# raw

```go
import "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/codec/raw"
```

Package raw is a gashe.Codec that stores \[\]byte and string values as they are, without the quotes and base64 of JSON, for pages, images or payloads that are already encoded.

<a name="Codec"></a>
## type [Codec](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/codec/raw/raw.go#L14-L16>)

Codec stores \[\]byte and string values as they are; other values go to Inner, and a nil Inner means gashe.JSON. GetOrLoad stores its result inside an entry of its own, so Codec helps only Get, Set and the other calls of the basic API.

```go
type Codec struct {
    Inner gashe.Codec
}
```
